plugin.name: Claude Code for Kasif
plugin.description:
Claude Code for Kasif is a JetBrains plugin by Birkan Kader that brings Claude Code conversations, project tools and local task controls into the IDE.

Features

  • Chat tabs with an always-visible new-tab button and a Turkish interface.
  • Low resource mode for hidden panels and long conversations.
  • Local process metrics, task queues and project-specific concurrency limits.
  • Conversation search, bookmarks and decision notes.
  • Project task templates and context preview.
  • Scheduled messages and automatic resume.

Version 0.2. Publisher: Birkan Kader. Claude provider authentication and usage charges apply. Install updates from a Kaşif ZIP using the IDE's Install Plugin from Disk action.

License

GNU AGPL v3. The license, copyright notices and corresponding source accompany the distribution. Provided without warranty.

plugin.change-notes:
0.34 - Claude Code for Kasif (2026-09-24)

  • Support IntelliJ IDEA 2023.1 and newer with Java 17 compatible plugin classes.

0.33 - Claude Code for Kasif (2026-09-17)

  • Queue multiple messages while a task is running and keep the active task uninterrupted.
  • Reorder queued messages or merge selected messages with their attachments.
  • Review the compact queue above the composer and restore it when reopening a chat.

0.31 - Claude Code for Kasif (2026-09-15)

  • Auto-resume on usage limit is enabled by default for new or unset preferences.
  • Saved global, project and session choices remain unchanged, including explicit opt-outs.
  • Automatic resume waits for the initial settings load before acting on its default.

0.3 - Claude Code for Kasif (2026-09-14)

  • Plugin updates are available through the custom repository at https://birkankader.com/plugins/kasif/updatePlugins.xml.
  • Add the repository once in IDE plugin settings to receive future updates without manually installing ZIP files.
  • Each release includes a matching source archive and SHA-256 checksums.

0.2 - Claude Code for Kasif (2026-09-11)

  • Automatic recovery from API errors and model-aware context budgets with compact and continue.
  • New messages preserve the active task; only the latest pending message is sent after it finishes.
  • Session settings use a JSON file to preserve valid settings through Windows CLI launchers.

0.1 - Claude Code for Kasif (2026-09-09)

Developer and publisher: Birkan Kader.

  • Chat tabs with a permanent new-tab button and Turkish interface.
  • Low resource mode, task controls and local resource metrics.
  • Conversation search, bookmarks, decision notes and task templates.
  • Context preview, scheduled messages and automatic resume.
  • Model-specific reasoning effort, applied reliably on the next message.
  • Correct context usage percentages and draft estimates that distinguish file references from later file reads.
  • Rapid prompts share one new conversation; failed sends preserve editor context on retry and report CLI write failures.
  • Closed tabs retain process ownership until exit; Windows cleanup uses at most two asynchronous commands.
  • IDE exit requests backend cleanup over RPC; disposed processes and WebView connections cannot restart.
  • Helper CLI commands participate in shutdown; cancelled MCP probes retain their slots until bounded process cleanup finishes.
  • Session switching and reconnects restore history; disconnected sends show errors without simulated responses.
  • Project-owned selection delivery and background retry avoid duplicate work and blocking cleanup on the UI thread.
  • Incremental CLI output decoding preserves split UTF-8 characters and avoids repeatedly scanning long incomplete lines.
  • Chat titles refresh tab presentation without VFS rename events, preserving Java inspection settings.
  • Moved tabs transfer native callbacks to their current panel; closed panels discard queued notifications on the UI thread.
  • MCP discovery runs only when its panel opens, with two concurrent detail probes at most.
  • Bounded IntelliJ repaint scheduling and stream diagnostics; duplicate session starts and Bash hook recursion guarded.
  • Fewer duplicate CLI initialization processes, non-blocking Windows metadata cleanup and startup timings.
  • Auto-resume toggle works before the first message; pending resumes survive failed sends and reconnects.
